next.reason: 1985: "The COPY statement must be preceded by a space and terminated by the separator period."; 2023: "shall be preceded by a space except when it is the first statement in a compilation group.". 2023 adds an exception: no preceding space is needed when COPY is the first statement in a compilation group. GR-7.2.3.4-6 still ends the COPY statement with the separator period.
